summary: Frontend-only Playwright UI testing of the new Direct Messages (DM) flow on the public preview URL. Created two fresh OTP-signup users (alice/bob), exercised: empty Messages page → new-message modal → user search → start conversation → send text message → message appears in thread → back-button → conversation now in list with correct preview & timestamp. Settings dm-privacy-selector pills (Everyone / Followers only) work and become green when active. Profile gear icon (own profile) navigates to /settings. Profile message icon (other user) opens/starts a conversation. Mobile 414×900 bottom nav still exposes a Messages link. ALL critical DM UI flows pass.

issues: The bottom-nav <a href='/messages'> link does not expose a data-testid. The spec recommended data-testid like 'bottomnav-messages' for testability. Same likely applies to Sidebar Messages nav — both still render an unread badge per code, but selecting them in tests requires href selectors. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add data-testid='bottomnav-messages' to the Messages link in BottomNav.jsx and data-testid='sidebar-messages' to Sidebar.jsx for robust selector-based tests of the unread-badge.
(Already flagged in iteration_2 — still applicable) Server-side: short-circuit self-DM before insert; preserve participants on DELETE & filter via hidden_for; validate attachment.url prefix.
critical_code_review_comments: Conversation.jsx onPickFile uses FileReader().readAsDataURL — fine, but the resulting base64 grows file size ~33%; the 4MB raw-size check is BEFORE encoding, so the final POST body for a 4MB file is ~5.3MB and may exceed server-side 'message_too_large'. Recommend either compressing/uploading via multipart or warning user at ~3MB.

Profile.jsx 'profile-message-btn' onClick uses messagesApi.start but swallows errors silently (`catch {/* ignore */}`). If the peer has dm_privacy='followers' and is not following the caller, the user sees nothing happen. Should show a toast / inline message.
Messages.jsx polls every 8s and Conversation.jsx every 5s without abort on unmount — risk of duplicate inflight requests when navigating fast. Consider AbortController or stale-state guards.
server.py is still 1285 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Split DM endpoints into routers/messages.py (carried over from iteration_2).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 fresh users via /api/auth/signup/start + signup/verify (OTP read from db.otps.code). They left one conversation with one message in the database (id: a423ef50882243b08233d1751a8d3535). Safe to leave (TEST_ prefix in emails).
context_for_next_testing_agent: DM frontend is fully working end-to-end. Reusable seed script: /app/test_reports/seed_dm_users.py creates 2 random TEST_ users via OTP. Public URL: https://social-feed-269.preview.emergentagent.com. All required data-testids in spec are present in Messages.jsx, Conversation.jsx, NewMessageModal.jsx, Settings.jsx, Profile.jsx. The only missing data-testid is on BottomNav/Sidebar Messages link (currently selectable only via href='/messages').
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the DM frontend flow.
